boundary.failed: The plugin "{name}" failed, so this area was turned off. The rest of the page is unaffected.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.intro: Plugin SDK {sdk}, Jelee web {version}. Enabling, disabling and reordering take effect at once.
plugins.storageNote: The server's plugin settings cannot be read now, so enablement, order and plugin settings are kept in this browser only.
plugins.orderHint: The order decides where each plugin's contributions appear on a page.
plugins.rejected: The manifest failed validation, so the plugin is not loaded:
plugins.deprecatedHook: Hook {hook} is deprecated since SDK {since} and will be removed in {removed}; use {replacement}.
plugins.failures: {count} errors caught since it started. Latest:
plugins.clearSettingsPrompt: Deletes every stored setting of "{name}": the site-wide ones and those in this browser.

permissions.catalogRead: Read item details, file summaries and the library list the current user may see (read only).
permissions.userRead: Read the current user's name, shown name, language and administrator flag.
permissions.settingsStorage: Keep its own settings in a separate namespace: administrators set them for everyone, other users' changes stay in their browser.
permissions.uiRoutes: Register pages under /x/ followed by the plugin ID.
permissions.uiTheme: Override design tokens (colors, corner radius, font).

issues.notObject: The manifest is not a JSON object.
issues.invalidId: The ID must be lowercase and dotted, such as vendor.name.
issues.invalidText: {field} needs nonempty text in all four languages.
issues.invalidVersion: version is not a valid semantic version.
issues.invalidSdkRange: sdkVersion is not a valid version range.
issues.invalidMinJelee: minJeleeVersion is not a valid semantic version.
issues.jeleeTooOld: Needs Jelee {required} or later; this is {current}.
issues.invalidPermissions: permissions must be an array without duplicates.
issues.invalidHooks: hooks must be a nonempty array without duplicates.
issues.unknownHook: Unknown hook {hook} (it may have been removed in a newer SDK).
issues.invalidDependencies: dependencies must map plugin IDs to valid version ranges.
issues.invalidEntry: entry must name a module next to the manifest, such as ./index.ts.
issues.invalidAuthor: author must be text of 1 to 80 characters.

problems.duplicateId: Another plugin already uses the ID {id}.
problems.dependencyVersion: Dependency {dependency} is {version}, which does not satisfy {range}.
problems.dependencyInactive: Dependency {dependency} ({range}) is disabled or cannot run.
problems.loadFailed: Could not load the plugin code: {error}
problems.invalidDefinition: The entry does not export a valid plugin definition (setup and messages in four languages).
problems.setupFailed: setup failed, so the plugin did not start: {error}

plugins.storageServer: Enablement, order and plugin settings are saved on the server and apply to every user and device.
plugins.saveFailed: Plugin settings could not be saved; the server's current settings were loaded again.
